brief.description: The complete brief in markdown, in the required format.

expectedFiles.description: Repo-relative paths (globs allowed) the PR is expected to touch, changeset excluded.

questions.description: Product decisions the plan does not make and the code cannot answer. Empty when the brief is complete.

notes.description: What you checked, changed or are unsure about (for the maintainer, not the implementer).

checks.description: The draft's commands the reviewer ran when its prompt asks for it, empty otherwise. Always empty from the writer.

exitCode.description: -1 when the command did not finish.

canPass.description: Whether the command can pass after a change within the expected files.

criteria.description: One entry per project criterion the prompt lists, empty when it lists none. Always empty from the writer.
